bestBets.overview: Kick this evenings meet off with a 1300m BM62. Note just ten can run. Not an easy map to predict. No's 1,4,5,6,7,8,9 all candidates to settle forward, not one of them does that all of the time, but enough of the time. DRACENA has been disappointing this time in, had five weeks to be sorted, would be hard to beat if back near best. If it wasn't right surely it would have been sent for a spell by now. THUNDER AWARD won well track/trip latest. A nation waits to see just what barrier it jumps from. FORT WILLIAM maps to be thereabouts which is often the case with this horse. HEAVENLY LOVE won nicely when resuming. Dropping back in distance a surprise,  who knows could be prepped differently now?

bestBets.overview: 1000m BM70. No's 1,2,3,4,6,7,10 look to be the pace. Sets up well for something to emerge from the back half. JEMELDI ticks that box, partakes off back to back wins, the massive concern is six times to Toowoomba have resulted in just two placings. THAT'S AN EXTRA also ticks that map box, fitter for the 1st-up 5th, the additional 130m can only be viewed positively. Re the pace KING JESTER can and should be the best hope. Draws soft, takes a claim, placed close 5th at Eagle Farm last start, just 2.6 L from the winner, and in the process that day had no joy in the straight. SHOWS A SIGN in the selections due to liking for the venue, as things stand won't be easy for it from out there.

bestBets.overview: 1625m BM58. Note just ten can run. No's 7,8,14,16,17 appears to be where the pace resides. Doubt all of them make the final field, time will tell. MADALSA is hard and fit and well, taking a claim a deserved relief for the mare. CLEARLY GEORGE in the mix, if the pace from the emergencies isn't in when the final scratchings are published, the map becomes sublime. LOCH AWE finds itself in an easier assignment, for all concerned the expectations should be high.
